svg.title: White Std
svg.desc: Plot: standard deviation of integrated white noise versus time, 0 to 300 seconds, with angle on the vertical axis (labeled "radians (degrees)"). The expected curve, sigma times the square root of t with sigma equal to 1, rises steeply at first and then more slowly, reaching about 17.3 at 300 seconds. The measured white-noise standard deviation closely tracks it, falling slightly below to about 16.5 by the end. This shows that integrated sensor noise causes error to grow with the square root of time.
